decisions.text: Arcade is a built-in style, like Play and HUD: style id and layout both 'arcade', always in the picker, and installing automatos/arcade switches the phone to it (BUILT_IN_THEME_STYLES 'automatos/arcade': 'arcade').
The theme id is automatos/arcade, first-party; its mobile block stays as the skin a build without the Arcade layout paints on Studio.

Looks are the web's (arcade-look/v1, interface 'arcade', five knobs, five presets), saved on the phone under styles.arcade.looks and synced through GET/PUT /api/themes/looks/automatos/arcade as Play's are; not installed → kept on the phone with words.
Press Start 2P and Pixelify Sans are bundled as static TTF with OFL; the app.json expo-font change makes the merge a native build (accepted, one build).

Auto in Arcade is the kit's code-drawn 32×32 sprite (vendored pure TS, drawn with Skia), twelve states on a 60 ms clock; frame 1 under Reduce Motion or paused; a pause control stops every loop (WCAG 2.2.2). The bundled clips never show in Arcade.

The home is the handheld: ▲ Quests → Board, ◀ Chat → home, ▶ Inventory → Deliverables, ▼ Menu → the header menu. The shared screens are dressed, never copied. Counters only from numbers the app already fetches; no new endpoint.
PRD-268's brief, suggestions and approval sheet are wired into Arcade by whichever lands second.
No WebView anywhere, in any style; nothing from a theme or the server is rendered as web content.
The app never loads JavaScript, CSS or HTML from a theme or the server. Arcade's drawing is vendored into the app's own source at a pinned kit commit, never downloaded.
The Command Centre, sheets and settings are ONE set of screens dressed by each style's tokens and the shared primitives; no screen is copied per style.
One voice screen, one dress per style: Arcade's rings take the palette's accent and the sprite sits in the core; colours come from the resolved style.
Layouts read tokens only. Colour literals live only in src/styles/tokens/ (the lint rule); the vendored Arcade catalogue and sprite colours live there too.

The AiLabel is one small muted caption that opens every thread in every style (the story window's first row) and sits on the voice screen; never a pill, never a lock. src/styles/ai-label.tsx is never edited (gate-enforced). Scanlines are never drawn over it.

Nothing below 11 pt (the design's small pixel labels are raised to 11); Dynamic Type with layouts that wrap; every colour status also has a word; every animated signal has a text twin; Reduce Motion and the pause control stop loops and show stills; tap targets 44 pt (the D-pad's 64).

Files 200-400 lines (never over 800), functions under 50, components under 150, nesting under 4; pure logic in plain TS with vitest tests beside it (pure modules import no react, react-native, expo-* or @shopify/react-native-skia); immutability; copy in src/styles/strings.ts.

This wave may create or change ONLY: src/styles/** (never src/styles/ai-label.tsx), src/ui/Slider.tsx and src/ui/dressed.ts (additive), src/voice/home/use-arcade-home-voice.ts, src/voice/home/arcade-home-voice.ts, src/voice/screen/**, src/voice/nav.ts, app/(app)/settings/look/arcade.tsx, assets/fonts/press-start-2p/**, assets/fonts/pixelify-sans/**, assets/fonts/SOURCES.md and app.json's expo-font list (US-022d only), docs/styles-and-themes.md, docs/prd/PRD-001-AUTOMATOS-GO-V1.md (US-022 boxes), CLAUDE.md (the styles count), and in US-022k the PRD-268 folders src/brief/**, src/suggestions/** and src/approvals/** where the base carries them (additive), the tests beside each, and this kit's files under scripts/ralph/. Never: src/core/**, core.lock.json, src/api/**, src/navigation/routes.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, eas.json, .eas/**, .github/**, any other assets/fonts/** family.
US-022a puts 'arcade' in every exhaustive map with Studio's value, each marked '// ARCADE_STAND_IN' naming its owner story; each later story removes its own; US-022k leaves none (gate-enforced).

Arcade's data and drawing come from the design kit (AutomatosAI/automatos-design-kit) at 034fa629c (themes/arcade): read with `git -C <workspace>/.worktrees/automatos-design-kit/kit-arcade-official show 034fa629c:themes/arcade/<path>` (or `gh api 'repos/AutomatosAI/automatos-design-kit/contents/themes/arcade/<path>?ref=034fa629c8ba79cff042559ca2d132f6d38f6d23'`). Each vendored file carries a header naming the kit path, the commit and the source's sha256; colour data goes under src/styles/tokens/. Never copy the kit's React/DOM code (its .tsx, CSS modules): port the behaviour.
No dependency change: Skia 2.2.12, reanimated, react-native-svg and expo-font are already in package.json.

Every edit outside src/styles/ (src/ui/*, src/voice/**, app/**, app.json, assets/fonts/**, docs, CLAUDE.md, the PRD-268 folders) is ADDITIVE and recorded in that story's DONE note as 'SEAM EDIT: <path> — <why>' (gate-enforced).
